prompt:
can you add proper smooth scrolling to this little vite + react landing page? we already use gsap scrolltrigger for a couple of reveals (see App.tsx). the header is fixed and 72px tall, so nav links like #pricing currently land under it. also the mobile menu overlay should stop the page scrolling behind it while it's open. please make it production quality — i don't want two scroll loops fighting or anything that breaks keyboard scrolling. just edit the files, no need to npm install.

Input files: package.json, src/App.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/index.css
assertions: Exactly one Lenis instance is created in the app (no second smooth-scroll library, no autoRaf alongside a manual raf loop)
Lenis is driven by gsap.ticker (gsap.ticker.add calling lenis.raf with time*1000) and gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0) is set
ScrollTrigger is updated from Lenis scroll events (lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) or equivalent)
The CSS rule html { scroll-behavior: smooth } is removed or neutralised because it conflicts with Lenis programmatic scrolling
In-page anchor navigation scrolls with a 72px (or header-height) offset so sections are not hidden under the fixed header
Anchor navigation moves keyboard focus to the target section (e.g. tabindex=-1 + focus) or otherwise preserves accessible focus
Opening the mobile menu stops scrolling (lenis.stop() or equivalent) and closing it restores scrolling (lenis.start())
The Lenis instance and the ticker callback are cleaned up on unmount (lenis.destroy() and gsap.ticker.remove)
The Lenis stylesheet (lenis/dist/lenis.css) or equivalent recommended CSS is included
